title: Gabor Frames of Totally Positive Functions: A Complete Characterization
summary: We prove that the set of time-frequency shifts $\{e^{2πi βl t} g(t-αk) : k,l \in \mathbb{Z}\}$ with a continuous, integrable totally positive function $g$ and lattice parameters $α,β>0$ generates a frame for $L^2(\mathbb{R})$ if and only if $αβ<1$. This fully settles the so-called frame set problem for the class of totally positive functions. As a closely related result we prove a sharp Kadets-type theorem for every shift-invariant space generated by a continuous totally positive function. The proofs are based on Fredholm theory and limit-operator theory. A formalization of our main result…
